s1.description: The problem: the surgeon’s MRI map goes wrong when the brain moves, and ultrasound matches can be wrong.

s2.description: Our solution: throw out the wrong matches, fix the map, check the fix.

s3.description: How it works: correct matches agree; finding them is a quantum puzzle built in Qiskit; the app.

s4.description: Results: 22 real patients, the self-check, real IBM hardware, three kinds of solver.

s5.description: What’s next: what quantum needs to win, what’s new and what’s missing.
